credit: Permafrost temperature: GTN-P boreholes (Biskaborn et al. 2019, Nature Communications 10, 264; data GTN-P 2018, PANGAEA, CC BY 3.0). Permafrost extent: ESA Climate Change Initiative, Permafrost_cci, extent for the Northern Hemisphere v5.0 (Westermann et al. 2025, NERC EDS CEDA). Borehole trends, areas and the 0.5° map computed for this site

boreholes.label: GTN-P boreholes (Biskaborn et al. 2019)
boreholes.source: Biskaborn et al. 2019, Nature Communications 10, 264; GTN-P 2018, PANGAEA
boreholes.what: mean annual ground temperature near the depth of zero annual amplitude; depth is where it was measured, zaa the depth of zero annual amplitude (m)
boreholes.trend: this site's least-squares trend, °C a decade, over a borehole's own years when it has at least 5
boreholes.paperResultsNote: the paper's change from 2007 to 2016, °C, with its stated uncertainty; it compares each borehole to its 2007-2009 mean, unlike the trends here

extent.label: ESA CCI Permafrost extent v5.0 (Westermann et al. 2025)
extent.source: ESA Climate Change Initiative, Permafrost_cci; NERC EDS CEDA
extent.licence: ESA CCI data policy: free and open, with credit
extent.seam: to 2002 the model is driven by bias-corrected ERA5 air temperature alone; from 2003 by MODIS land-surface temperature
extent.zoneNote: a cell's share comes from seven model runs, so it moves in sevenths; the isolated zone (under 10%) is all but empty

map.units: percent of the ground underlain by permafrost
